name: comp-553
title: Mixed File Upload Manager
blurb: Mixed file and image uploads in a unified grid interface.
description: Multi-file uploader displaying both images as thumbnails and other files as type icons in a single grid. All removable.
use_when: Media + document uploads, unified file management, flexible asset collections.
avoid_when: File-type-specific flows; use specialized variants for single-type focus.
a11y: Grid structure with accessible file type indicators and remove buttons.
